cat.name: Adult domestic cat
cat.tagline: Save a spot by the window
cat.note: Cats need litter, places to scratch and an enriching environment. Individual personalities vary widely.

small_dog.name: Adult small dog
small_dog.note: Dogs need daily outings, training and company. Small dogs can still need a lot of care.

rabbit.name: Domestic rabbit
rabbit.tagline: Quiet, with a mind of its own
rabbit.note: Rabbits need a safe exercise area, a suitable diet and a vet experienced with rabbits. They require substantial care.

hamster.name: Hamster
hamster.note: Hamsters need plenty of continuous space to explore and suitable bedding. They are active at night. Appearance alone gives little information about their care needs.

hedgehog.name: African pygmy hedgehog
hedgehog.note: Hedgehogs are more active at night and need a suitable temperature, places to hide and specialised care.

leopard_gecko.name: Leopard gecko
leopard_gecko.tagline: A spotted coat and a low stroll
leopard_gecko.note: Leopard geckos need an enclosure with a temperature gradient and hiding places, plus a variety of live feeder insects.

budgie.name: Budgerigar group
budgie.tagline: A little more sound in your day
budgie.note: Budgerigars need company from their own species, space to fly and a clean environment. Feathers and dust may also cause discomfort.

aquarium.name: Freshwater aquarium
aquarium.note: A freshwater aquarium needs water quality management, a cycled tank and a suitable tank size. Assess the species, number of fish and their lifespans separately.

nailong.name: Naylong
nailong.note: A round, yellow companion from a world of make-believe. You can enjoy spending time with this fictional character without planning a pet care budget.
